info.name: Online Store API
info.description: Every endpoint of the Online Store backend. Set the collection variable baseUrl to http://localhost:5000 (local) or your Render address. Postman keeps the login cookie automatically after "Log in". Full details: docs/api.md.

item.name: Health
item.description: Is the API up, and can it reach the database?

item.name: Auth
item.description: Accounts. Log in first: the login cookie is then sent with every request automatically.

request.description: Answers { user } (logged in) or { requiresCode: true } when login codes are on.
Only when login codes are on. Uses the loginChallenge cookie from Log in.

item.name: Cart
item.description: Works for guests (guestCart cookie) and logged-in shoppers.

request.description: cartItemId is the line id from Get cart (items[].id), not the product id.

item.name: Checkout
item.description: Start a payment, pay in the browser (test number 0551234987), then verify.

request.description: Copy checkout.reference into the reference variable and open checkout.authorizationUrl to pay.

item.name: Orders
item.description: The confirmation page (no login), My Orders and cancelling (login).

item.name: Reviews
item.description: The public list, and your own review (login; you must have received the product).

item.name: Admin
item.description: Log in as the admin (ADMIN_EMAIL / ADMIN_PASSWORD from .env) first. Change the email and password variables, or edit the Log in body.

request.description: Note stock: send it as expectedStock when changing the stock.
Use a real ImageKit address. The name must be unique.
expectedStock = the stock shown by Product details. A different value gives 409 with currentStock.

item.name: Webhooks
item.description: Called by Paystack, not by people. Sent from Postman it has no valid signature, so the expected answer is 401: that proves the signature check works.
